subtitle: The same action you take by hand, done by a program instead

steps.label: Application
steps.sub: the software that has the data or does the work

steps.label: Programming
steps.sub: a defined way for code to talk to that software

steps.label: Interface
steps.sub: the actual door — specific requests it will answer

code:
By hand (UI):
  Log in, open Payables, search invoices,
  read the amount off the screen

By API (program):
GET /fscmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/invoices
  -> JSON with the same invoice data
caption: An API is a second door into the same application — one a program can open.
